text: Watch the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer - Rockstar Games Skip the Menu Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Get Launcher Open Search Open Player Menu Open Player Menu \> Newswire Grand Theft Auto VI Announcements Watch the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer Listen to the New Single “Flower in a Hurricane” from Justice October 15, 2026 Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. Check out the new Launch Trailer , featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI. The new standalone Justice single, “ Flower in a Hurricane ” feat. Tame Impala , SZA , and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard , is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD at gtavi-thealbum.com . Stay tuned for more information on the music of Grand Theft Auto VI, including the official score album. Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19 to PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S.
